  <section class="section intro-grid"><div><div class="eyebrow">ABOUT THE LAB</div><h2>Engineering insight.<br><span>Quantified uncertainty.</span><br>Resilient systems.</h2></div><div><p>SHARE Lab explores the behavior and performance of built infrastructure under uncertain environmental loads and natural hazards. By integrating probabilistic methods, computational modeling, and data-driven analysis, we aim to understand risk and support more resilient infrastructure systems.</p><div class="word-tags"><span class="word-tag">Uncertainty Quantification</span><span class="word-tag">Natural Hazards</span><span class="word-tag">System Interactions</span><span class="word-tag">Risk & Resilience</span></div></div></section>
